# Business rules

One page per business rule, with its id, its status and the history of its changes. This list is generated from the pages of the folder; edit the pages, never this file.

| Id | Rule | Status | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| BR-ACCESS-001 | [Only signed-in users reach the catalog](Only-signed-in-users-reach-the-catalog.md) | active | Every request to the catalog, including reading and the service description, needs a signed-in user. |
| BR-ACCESS-002 | [Viewers read, editors change](Viewers-read-editors-change.md) | active | A viewer only reads products, an editor also creates, changes, deletes and imports them, and the screen hides the buttons a viewer cannot use. |
| BR-ACCESS-003 | [Code lists are readable by every signed-in user](Code-lists-are-readable-by-every-signed-in-user.md) | active | Categories, subcategories, currencies and the other fixed lists are open to reading for any signed-in user, and no role changes them. |
| BR-DETAILS-001 | [Detail rows follow the attributes of the subcategory](Detail-rows-follow-the-attributes-of-the-subcategory.md) | active | A draft keeps one detail row per attribute of the product's subcategory and tells the user which filled values were dropped when the subcategory changes. |
| BR-DETAILS-002 | [An attribute is used once per product and belongs to the subcategory](An-attribute-is-used-once-per-product-and-belongs-to-the-subcategory.md) | active | A detail row names an attribute that its product's subcategory offers, and a product has at most one row per attribute. |
| BR-DETAILS-003 | [A detail value matches the value type of its attribute](A-detail-value-matches-the-value-type-of-its-attribute.md) | active | A value goes only in the place its attribute's value type allows: text for TEXT, a number for INTEGER and DECIMAL, one list value for LIST, selections for MULTI_LIST. |
| BR-DETAILS-004 | [A number detail stays within its bounds and is whole when required](A-number-detail-stays-within-its-bounds-and-is-whole-when-required.md) | active | A number value respects the minimum and maximum of its attribute, and an INTEGER attribute takes a whole number. |
| BR-DETAILS-005 | [A list detail value belongs to the list of its attribute](A-list-detail-value-belongs-to-the-list-of-its-attribute.md) | active | The value of a LIST attribute must be one of the values defined for that attribute and no other. |
| BR-DETAILS-006 | [A value of a multi-choice detail is selected once and belongs to its list](A-value-of-a-multi-choice-detail-is-selected-once-and-belongs-to-its-list.md) | active | A several-choice row holds each chosen value once, every chosen value is required and belongs to the attribute's list. |
| BR-DETAILS-007 | [A detail that the subcategory requires must be filled](A-detail-that-the-subcategory-requires-must-be-filled.md) | planned | A subcategory will be able to mark an attribute as required, and a product of that subcategory will need a value for it. |
| BR-DETAILS-008 | [A detail number stays within the bounds of its subcategory](A-detail-number-stays-within-the-bounds-of-its-subcategory.md) | planned | A subcategory will be able to narrow the bounds of a number attribute for its own products. |
| BR-DETAILS-009 | [Storage is not below memory](Storage-is-not-below-memory.md) | planned | The storage of a laptop will not be allowed to be below its memory. |
| BR-DETAILS-010 | [Battery life is available only for a wireless device](Battery-life-is-available-only-for-a-wireless-device.md) | planned | The battery life of a product will be enabled only while the product has a wireless connection value selected. |
| BR-DETAILS-011 | [Memory is a power of two](Memory-is-a-power-of-two.md) | planned | The memory of a laptop will have to be a power of two. |
| BR-IMPORT-001 | [An import creates all products or none](An-import-creates-all-products-or-none.md) | active | An Excel import writes every row as an active product, or writes nothing and lists every problem of the file at once. |
| BR-IMPORT-002 | [The header row names known columns once and includes the mandatory ones](The-header-row-names-known-columns-once-and-includes-the-mandatory-ones.md) | active | The first row of the workbook may name only the supported columns, each once, and must include name, price, currency, stock, category and subcategory. |
| BR-IMPORT-003 | [The import file is an xlsx workbook with product rows within the size limits](The-import-file-is-an-xlsx-workbook-with-product-rows-within-the-size-limits.md) | active | The file must be a readable .xlsx workbook with at least one product row, at most 1,000 rows, and not more than 10 MB of unpacked data. |
| BR-IMPORT-004 | [An imported product name must be new](An-imported-product-name-must-be-new.md) | active | A row is refused when its name equals the name of an active product or of an earlier row of the same file. |
| BR-IMPORT-005 | [Every imported row follows the rules of a product](Every-imported-row-follows-the-rules-of-a-product.md) | active | Each row is written through the same checks as any product, and a row that breaks one is reported with its row number, column and reason. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-001 | [The subcategory belongs to the product's category](The-subcategory-belongs-to-the-products-category.md) | active | A product carries only a subcategory of its own category, so a pair from two categories is never stored. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-002 | [A product is created and changed through a draft](A-product-is-created-and-changed-through-a-draft.md) | active | New and changed products are first kept as a private draft that is checked at Save, and a draft locks its product for other users and is marked in the list. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-003 | [A product needs a name, price, currency, stock, category and subcategory](A-product-needs-a-name-price-currency-stock-category-and-subcategory.md) | active | A product cannot be saved while its name, price, currency, stock, category or subcategory is empty. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-004 | [Price, stock and rating stay within their bounds](Price-stock-and-rating-stay-within-their-bounds.md) | active | The price is from 0 to 99,999,999.99, the stock from 0 to 1,000,000 and the rating from 0 to 5. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-005 | [Category, subcategory and currency must exist](Category-subcategory-and-currency-must-exist.md) | active | A product can only name a category, a subcategory and a currency that exist in the catalog's lists. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-006 | [The subcategory field stays disabled until a category is chosen](The-subcategory-field-stays-disabled-until-a-category-is-chosen.md) | active | On the product form the Subcategory field cannot be used until a category is chosen, and it is marked required from then on. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-007 | [Changing the category clears a subcategory that no longer fits](Changing-the-category-clears-a-subcategory-that-no-longer-fits.md) | active | When the category of a draft changes, a subcategory that belongs to the old category is cleared at once and without a message. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-008 | [A subcategory change must not leave details that do not fit](A-subcategory-change-must-not-leave-details-that-do-not-fit.md) | active | A product is never stored with detail rows for attributes its subcategory does not offer; a draft drops them with a warning and a direct write is refused. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-009 | [A product name has at least three characters](A-product-name-has-at-least-three-characters.md) | planned | A product name will need at least three characters once leading and trailing spaces are removed. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-010 | [A product name is unique in the catalog](A-product-name-is-unique-in-the-catalog.md) | planned | A product name will have to be new in the catalog, ignoring capital letters and spaces at both ends. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-011 | [A price is above zero](A-price-is-above-zero.md) | planned | A price will have to be above zero, so a free product is refused. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-012 | [A price in a currency without minor units has no decimals](A-price-in-a-currency-without-minor-units-has-no-decimals.md) | planned | A price in a currency without minor units, such as JPY or KRW, will have to be a whole amount. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-013 | [An image address uses https and has no spaces](An-image-address-uses-https-and-has-no-spaces.md) | planned | The image address of a product will have to start with https and contain no spaces. |
| BR-PRODUCTS-014 | [A product in stock needs a description](A-product-in-stock-needs-a-description.md) | planned | A product with stock above zero will need a description. |
